tasks.description: Merges BibTeX files into one consistently formatted file with canonical venue names and duplicates removed. Use when asked to normalize or merge the BibTeX files of a project.
tasks.intent: Normalize and merge BibTeX files into one deduplicated file.

tasks.description: Finds BibTeX entries that cite the same work twice and citation keys reused for different works. Use when asked for a duplicate entry report on BibTeX files.
tasks.intent: Report duplicate BibTeX entries and reused citation keys.

tasks.description: Checks BibTeX entries against the required fields of their entry type and lists what is missing. Use when asked for a missing-field report on BibTeX files.
tasks.intent: Report BibTeX entries that lack required fields.
